purpose: Apply the unchanged P0739 velocity-blind THINGS moment-0 and SINGS registration to the two predeclared validation galaxies without opening moment-1, moment-2, or SPARC velocity targets.
permittedInputs: THINGS natural-weighted moment 0 image and FITS header for the two validation systems
SINGS IRAC channel-1 image, weight image, and FITS headers for the two validation systems
SPARC sky coordinate, distance, inclination, H I mass, 3.6 micron luminosity, effective radius, and Hubble type
forbiddenInputs: SPARC observed rotation speeds or errors
any gravity-formula prediction, score, or parameter

processing.method: Bit-for-bit P0739 implementation generalized only to honor the split named by this config.
processing.positionAngle: robust SINGS second moments inside five effective radii
processing.foregroundSuppression: 12 robust-MAD compact residual rule with central 0.2-effective-radius protection
processing.extent: 1.20 times max(H I R995, six effective radii)

claimBoundary: P0745A is a validation-split observational registration test, not a gravity-formula score.
Its algorithm and gates were copied from P0739 before validation image arrays were opened.
Failure of the SINGS footprint gate is allowed to remain visible because the frozen P0745B WISE fusion is the predeclared repair.
No velocity or dispersion target may be opened in this stage, and both holdout galaxies remain sealed.
